text:
**My pick: the Belkin 3-in-1 Qi2 Charging Stand.** WIRED named it best overall after testing 30+ models. It charges an iPhone at up to 15W, fast-charges an Apple Watch Series 7 or newer, and has a base pad for AirPods. It also supports landscape/StandBy mode and comes with a 36W power supply and a 2-year warranty. WIRED lists it at $109, with $98 at the first retailer shown, $90 on Amazon and $80 at Best Buy. Prices change, so check at checkout. WIRED's page has the shop links: https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/

**Other good options, by need:**
- **Fastest: Nomad Stand One Max ($169).** It does Qi2 25W for the iPhone, but no power adapter is included. You need a 40W one, and WIRED suggests Nomad's 40W Slim Adapter at $25. https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/
- **Cheapest: ESR Qi2 3-in-1 (about $40 on Amazon, down from $80 per WIRED).** It gives 15W with a brick and cable included. The Apple Watch charger is a separate unit that slots into the back, and warranty is only 1 year. https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/
- **Lies flat for the nightstand: Nimble Podium ($130).** It supports 25W, but Apple Watch charging is slow, so it suits overnight use. https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-wireless-chargers/
- **Travel: Anker MagGo 3-in-1 (about $80, down from $110).** It folds compactly and charges at 15W. https://www.wired.com/gallery/best-apple-3-in-1-travel-chargers/
- **Faster folding stand: ESR CryoBoost 25W ($99.99).** It has a cooling fan with an off button. Dealectric says code PARTNER18 brought it to $82 when tested on Oct 25, but checkout has the final word. Buy here (affiliate link, Dealectric earns a commission at no cost to you): https://dealectric.com/go/esr-cryoboost-3-in-1-qi2-2-25w-stand
- **Tall desk stand that folds: Satechi 3-in-1 Qi2 25W ($129.99).** Macworld says it is the tallest and most adjustable foldable stand it has tested, and it includes a 45W adapter. https://www.macworld.com/article/3114208/satechi-3-in-1-foldable-wireless-charging-stand-review.html

**Before you buy:**
- 25W only helps iPhone 16 and 17 models. If you charge overnight, 15W is fine, and WIRED says the faster ESR version isn't worth the extra money.
- The AirPods case needs wireless charging support to use the third position.
